item.title: Early voting draws large turnout in Wake County, but not long lines
item.description: It’s the first day of early voting in North Carolina, and in Wake County, election officials say turnout is already on track to break records.

item.title: Dad present when teens died in Vance County home; other siblings lived in house near Henderson: Sheriff
item.description: Vance County authorities said Friday that the father of four siblings was at home when two of those children -- both teenagers -- were found dead earlier this week.

item.title: Chatham County teacher facing 10 counts of sexually exploiting children: NCSBI
item.description: A teacher at a Chatham County school was arrested Friday on felony charges connected to the sexual exploitation of children, the North Carolina State Bureau of Investigation said.

item.title: Durham mom charged with murder, attempted murder of children: Police
item.description: A Durham woman was identified as the suspect in an incident Thursday afternoon that left one of her children dead and another hospitalized, police said.

item.title: North Carolina State Board of Elections investigating reports of fake registration officials
item.description: As early voting is underway, the North Carolina State Board of Elections is investigating reports of people posing as state election officials and telling others to re-register to vote.
